zh: 所需核心数就是任意时刻同时运行的进程数的最大值。注意区间两端都包含：进程在 end 那一刻仍在运行。
把每个进程拆成两个事件：start 时刻 +1，end+1 时刻 −1。按时间排序后从左到右扫描，当前累计值就是该时刻正在运行的进程数。
为每个进程生成 (start, +1) 和 (end+1, −1) 两个事件；按时间排序，同一时刻让 −1 排在 +1 前面（这样恰好在 end+1 时释放的核心可以复用）；扫描时累加并记录最大值，输出这个最大值。
en: The number of cores needed is the maximum number of processes running at the same moment. Both ends are inclusive: a process is still running at time end.
Split each process into two events: +1 at start and -1 at end+1. After sorting by time and scanning from left to right, the running total is the number of processes active at that moment.

Create events (start, +1) and (end+1, -1) for each process; sort by time, putting -1 before +1 at equal times (so a core released at end+1 can be reused right away); accumulate while scanning, track the maximum, and print it.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Create a +1 event at each start and a −1 event one moment after each end, sort by time, scan while keeping the current concurrency, and take the maximum.

## Proof of correctness

Because the interval endpoints are inclusive, a process is still running at time end, so its core is released only at end+1. After scanning past any event, the current count is exactly the number of processes running at that moment; its maximum is a lower bound on the cores needed over all moments, and that many cores suffice for a schedule.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time, O(n) space.
